description: Reserve stock for up to 10 products and return a Stripe Checkout link that a human opens in a browser to pay. The link expires in 30 minutes; the reservation is released if it is not paid. Shipping address, name and phone are entered on the Stripe page — do not collect them yourself. For Canada the card is charged in CAD at a fixed rate (returned as charged_amount_cents). This tool does not take payment; only the customer does, on that page. Pass a stable client_request_id so a retry returns the same link instead of reserving stock twice.

agent.description: Name of the calling agent, for the merchant's records

ship_to.description: Destination country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (CA, US, JP)

name: nodajimarket_create_checkout
title: Create a checkout link
